summary.whatChanges: Upgrades the repo's package manager from pnpm 10.33.1 to 12.4.1 (engines + packageManager + lockfile entry), bumps the CI pnpm/action-setup action to v6, deletes .npmrc and moves its settings into pnpm-workspace.yaml with an expanded allowBuilds list and a minimumReleaseAgeExclude, and switches the two Railway example configs from the NIXPACKS builder to RAILPACK.
behaviorChanges: Local installs and CI now require/use pnpm 12.4.1; pnpm ^12.0.0 is enforced via engines.
Install settings (public hoisting, strict-peer-dependencies off, workspace linking, --no-warnings) now come from pnpm-workspace.yaml instead of .npmrc.
Postinstall build scripts are now explicitly allowed for many packages (prisma, playwright, sharp, esbuild, swc, workerd, etc.) instead of only esbuild.
The lockfile now pins pnpm itself as a packageManagerDependency with platform-specific @pnpm/exe binaries.
Railway deployments of the websockets-starter and sse-chat examples build with RAILPACK instead of NIXPACKS.
risks: Major pnpm version jump (10 → 12) can change hoisting/resolution behavior and break installs or builds for contributors still on pnpm 10.
Removing .npmrc means any tool or environment that reads .npmrc settings (rather than pnpm-workspace.yaml) loses them.
Switching Railway examples to the RAILPACK builder may change the runtime image or break deploys that relied on NIXPACKS.
packages/client/bin/intent.js was modified but its contents are not visible in the diff, so its effect is unverified.
